documents.quality_note: AI appears in the list of violations (assistance from AI not authorized, dependence on AI prohibited by the instructor, use of AI work without acknowledgement, submitting AI work as one's own). The rest covers hearing procedures; 'AI' in the procedures section abbreviates 'academic integrity' allegation. Landing page (text: v2-pittsburgh-ssoe-integrity-page.txt) only links to the PDF.
